title: Swift for TensorFlow: The Next-Generation Machine Learning Framework (TF Dev Summit '19)
summary: Chris Lattner and Brennan Saeta present Swift for TensorFlow at the TensorFlow Dev Summit 2019, covering language-integrated automatic differentiation and tooling for machine learning in Swift.
why: Cited as the source for Google's Swift for TensorFlow effort, later remembered as a once-hyped ML language.

quote.text: This one is very interesting and unexpected.
